description_en: Resets the password of a database account for a specified cluster
description_zh: 重置指定集群的数据库账号密码
kebab_example: aliyun adb reset-account-password --db-cluster-id 'amv-bp11q28kvl688****' --account-name test_accout --account-password Test_accout1 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPassword

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The database account.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612430.html operation to query the database account information of a specified cluster, including the database accounts
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612430.html接口查看指定集群的数据库账号信息，包括数据库账号
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include: `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
特殊符号包含：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the account.
The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
账号描述。
不能以`http://`和`https://` 开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.
Clickhouse: wide table engine
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB MySQL引擎。
Clickhouse：宽表引擎
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_name
